# Format fixtures

Synthetic PDFs rendered from the original
[narrative corpus](../narrative/story.md), which is project-authored and not
taken from a real book. Regenerate them from the repository root with
`node scripts/format_fixtures.mjs`. The script uses the web workspace's
Playwright Chromium and Ghostscript.

| File | Derivation | Expected parser outcome |
|---|---|---|
| `story.pdf` | Chromium print, A5, one chapter per page, DejaVu Serif | Five chapters; every passage anchored to its chapter's page |
| `outlined.pdf` | Ghostscript `-dNoOutputFonts`: glyphs become vector outlines | `TEXT_LAYER_UNAVAILABLE`, like a scan without OCR |
| `encrypted.pdf` | Ghostscript with synthetic owner/user passwords | `PDF_ENCRYPTED` |

Rendering depends on installed fonts, so regenerated bytes can differ. Rerun
`apps/api/tests/test_pdf_parsing.py` after any regeneration.
